message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/open62541 && python3 - <<'PY'
import json,sys,os
p='/workspace/candidate_trace.json'
trace=[
 {"step":1,"file":"tests/fuzz/fuzz_binary_message.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":16,"var":"data,size","code":"memcpy(msg.data, data, size);","note":"Attacker-controlled fuzz input is copied into a UA_ByteString and handed to the binary message processor."},
 {"step":2,"file":"src/ua_server.c","function":"UA_Server_processBinaryMessage","line":null,"var":"msg","code":"Processes the received binary chunk as an OPC UA message.","note":"The parser interprets the raw bytes and can dispatch discovery-related service requests embedded in the message."},
 {"step":3,"file":"src/server/ua_services_discovery.c","function":"Service_RegisterServer2","line":324,"var":"request.discoveryConfiguration[0]","code":"mdnsConfig = (UA_MdnsDiscoveryConfiguration *)object->content.decoded.data;","note":"A decoded RegisterServer2 request can supply an mDNS discovery configuration with attacker-controlled server name and discovery URL fields."},
 {"step":4,"file":"src/server/ua_services_discovery.c","function":"Service_RegisterServer2","line":351,"var":"requestServer->serverNames[0].text","code":"if(!mdnsServerName && requestServer->serverNamesSize) mdnsServerName = &requestServer->serverNames[0].text;","note":"If no explicit mDNS name is present, the server name from the request is used as the record name."},
 {"step":5,"file":"src/server/ua_services_discovery_multicast.c","function":"UA_Discovery_update_MdnsForDiscoveryUrl","line":206,"var":"path","code":"UA_parseEndpointUrl(discoveryUrl, &hostname, &port, &path);","note":"The discovery URL is parsed and its path component is extracted for later concatenation."},
 {"step":6,"file":"src/server/ua_mdns.c","function":"UA_Discovery_addRecord","line":478,"var":"pathChars","code":"memcpy(pathChars, path->data, path->length);","note":"The parsed path is copied into a stack buffer and passed to mDNS TXT creation."},
 {"step":7,"file":"src/server/ua_mdns.c","function":"setTxt","line":417,"var":"entry->pathTmp","code":"entry->pathTmp = UA_STRDUP(path);","note":"If the TXT path arrives before SRV, it is cached in heap memory for later use."},
 {"step":8,"file":"src/server/ua_mdns.c","function":"mdns_append_path_to_url","line":397,"var":"url->length + pathLen","code":"char *newUrl = (char *)UA_malloc(url->length + pathLen); memcpy(newUrl, url->data, url->length); memcpy(newUrl + url->length, path, pathLen);","note":"The cached or received path is appended without allocating space for a terminating NUL byte, so the resulting discovery URL buffer is unterminated and can trigger an out-of-bounds read when later treated as a C string."}
]
with open(p,'w') as f: json.dump(trace,f)
PY
bash ./submit.sh /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/open62541/tests/fuzz/fuzz_binary_message.cc /workspace/candidate_trace.json
